cases.name: alias_initializer_shadow
cases.source:
import "support.gst" as protected;
func main() int { mut ctx := os.Arena.New(); mut value: protected.ProtectedValue[ctx]; value.value = 7; mut owner := protected.acquire(&value,41); if 1 { mut ctx := &ctx; ctx.Free(); } protected.consume(owner); return 0; }

cases.source:
func copied_vector_value(ctx:&Arena) int {mut values:std.Vector[int,ctx]:=std.VectorNew(ctx);values.Push(1);mut slot:Index[std.Vector[int,ctx],ctx]:=os.ArenaAlloc(ctx);ctx.Set(slot,values);mut copied:std.Vector[int,ctx]:=ctx[slot];return copied[0];}
func main() int {mut ctx:=os.Arena.New();os.LogInt(copied_vector_value(&ctx));return 0;}
